market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. 4-day losing streak, CPI-driven Fed hike expectations, oil above $108, and yields near 5% create headwinds. Expect continued volatility into CPI reaction. Energy outperforms; tech selective. Watch for 5th consecutive down day as potential capitulation signal.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Dell, Nvidia, Cognizant) and energy transition (LNG demand) provide structural growth. However, sustained 5%+ yields and consumer stress cap multiple expansion. 6-12 month path depends on Fed pausing after 1-2 hikes and oil stabilizing below $100.
